sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: This page creates a new Google Workspace user. It collects personal info, account info, institution/title/phone, email signature and group assignment in a single form. When the form is submitted, the account is created directly in Google Workspace.

bullets.desc: Forms the name shown on the user's Google profile.
The username and domain combine to form the sign-in email address.
The initial sign-in password; the user can optionally be forced to change it at first sign-in.
The organizational unit the user is placed in.

sections.heading: Institution
paragraphs: An institution is the branch or location where the user works. The selected institution's name, address and phone are written to the user's organization info in Google.
These values are used in the email signature template as the {{kurum_adi}}, {{kurum_adres}} and {{kurum_telefon}} variables — so the user's signature automatically carries the correct branch details.

callout.text: Institutions are managed under Settings → Institutions. This feature is meant for organizations with multiple branches or locations; each branch is defined as a separate institution with its own name, address and phone. Single-location companies can define just one institution.

sections.heading: Title
paragraphs: The title is the user's role (Manager, Teacher, Specialist, etc.). It is written to the user's "Job title" field in Google and appears in the email signature as the {{unvan}} variable.

callout.text: The title list is managed under Settings → Titles; you can add new titles there or bulk-import them via CSV.

sections.heading: Phone
paragraphs: The phone number is written to the user's phone field in Google and used in the email signature as the {{telefon}} variable. The number is formatted automatically as you type.

callout.text: Phone is optional. If left blank, the conditional phone row in the signature template is hidden automatically for that user.

bullets.desc: When you select a signature template, the Gmail signature is applied automatically in the background after the user is created.
You can add the user to one or more Google groups during creation.

callout.text: A Service Account must be configured for signature delivery. If it is not configured, the signature step is skipped.
